name: x402-manifest-fixer
description: Tell one host exactly what to change to make its /.well-known/x402 manifest valid — and the _x402 TXT record to publish alongside it.

scripts.verify-vendor: curl -fsS https://raw.githubusercontent.com/whawk46/flareclaw-x402-trust/main/src/discovery.ts -o /tmp/canonical-discovery.ts && diff -q src/discovery.ts /tmp/canonical-discovery.ts && echo 'vendored copy matches the canonical source'
